```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

source("../../config/paths.R")

experiment_name <- "gt_100taxa_high_signal"
beast_run_name <- "dynamic_sequence_gt"

paths <- make_run_paths(experiment_name)

sim_data_path <- file.path(
  paths$sim_data_dir,
  paste0(experiment_name, "_sim_data.rds")
)

beast_output_dir <- paths$beast_output_dir
xml_dir <- paths$xml_dir
validation_dir <- paths$validation_dir
```


# Purpose

This file creates a frozen-tree XML from one dynamic snapshot. The resulting BEAST run disables sequence likelihood and tree proposals and only repeats the generation-time Gibbs machinery on that fixed tree.



Run this after `06_validate_dynamic_conditional_gaussian.Rmd`.

The default chosen snapshot (`freeze_source_snapshot_id <- NULL`) will automatically freeze the dynamic snapshot with the largest Mahalanobis^2 / df. This targets the most inflated dynamic snapshot for the frozen-tree control run.


```{r helpers}
library(Matrix)
library(ape)

if (!file.exists(sim_data_path)) {
  stop("Simulation data not found. Run 01_simulate_data.Rmd first: ", sim_data_path)
}

sim_data <- readRDS(sim_data_path)
y <- sim_data$y

list_snapshot_ids <- function(beast_output_dir, prefix_regex = "snapshot") {
  state_files <- list.files(
    beast_output_dir,
    pattern = "_state[.]csv$",
    full.names = FALSE
  )

  ids <- sub("_state[.]csv$", "", state_files)
  ids[grepl(prefix_regex, ids)]
}

read_snapshot <- function(snapshot_id, beast_output_dir) {
  snapshot_prefix <- file.path(beast_output_dir, snapshot_id)

  list(
    tree_edges = read.csv(
      paste0(snapshot_prefix, "_tree_edges.csv"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      check.names = FALSE,
      na.strings = ""
    ),
    precision = read.csv(
      paste0(snapshot_prefix, "_precision_triplets.csv"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      check.names = FALSE,
      na.strings = ""
    ),
    state = read.csv(
      paste0(snapshot_prefix, "_state.csv"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      check.names = FALSE,
      na.strings = ""
    )
  )
}

truthy <- function(x) {
  tolower(as.character(x)) == "true"
}
```


# settings

```{r settings}
freeze_chain_length <- 5000
freeze_snapshot_frequency <- 100

# If NULL, use the dynamic snapshot with the largest Mahalanobis² / df.
freeze_source_snapshot_id <- NULL
```

# Choose source snapshot

```{r choose-snapshot}
dynamic_results_path <- file.path(
  validation_dir,
  paste0("dynamic_conditional_gaussian_results_", beast_run_name, ".rds")
)

if (is.null(freeze_source_snapshot_id)) {
  if (!file.exists(dynamic_results_path)) {
    stop("No dynamic conditional results found. Run 06_validate_dynamic_conditional_gaussian.Rmd first.")
  }

  dynamic_results <- readRDS(dynamic_results_path)

  freeze_source_snapshot_id <- dynamic_results$snapshot_id[
    which.max(dynamic_results$mahalanobis2_per_df)
  ]
}

cat("Frozen-tree source snapshot:", freeze_source_snapshot_id, "\n")
```

# Convert snapshot edges to phylo

```{r snapshot-to-phylo}
snapshot_edges_to_phylo <- function(tree_edges_snapshot) {

  tip_rows <- tree_edges_snapshot[truthy(tree_edges_snapshot$is_leaf), ]
  internal_rows <- tree_edges_snapshot[!truthy(tree_edges_snapshot$is_leaf), ]

  root_rows <- tree_edges_snapshot[truthy(tree_edges_snapshot$is_root), ]

  tip_node_nrs <- sort(tip_rows$node_nr)
  root_node_nr <- root_rows$node_nr[1]

  other_internal_node_nrs <- sort(
    setdiff(internal_rows$node_nr, root_node_nr)
  )

  internal_node_nrs <- c(root_node_nr, other_internal_node_nrs)

  n_tips <- length(tip_node_nrs)
  n_internal <- length(internal_node_nrs)

  old_to_new <- setNames(
    integer(n_tips + n_internal),
    as.character(c(tip_node_nrs, internal_node_nrs))
  )

  old_to_new[as.character(tip_node_nrs)] <- seq_len(n_tips)

  old_to_new[as.character(internal_node_nrs)] <-
    n_tips + seq_len(n_internal)

  edge_rows <- tree_edges_snapshot[!truthy(tree_edges_snapshot$is_root), ]

  edge <- cbind(
    as.integer(old_to_new[as.character(edge_rows$parent_nr)]),
    as.integer(old_to_new[as.character(edge_rows$node_nr)])
  )

  phy <- list(
    edge = edge,
    edge.length = as.numeric(edge_rows$length),
    tip.label = tip_rows$node_id[match(tip_node_nrs, tip_rows$node_nr)],
    Nnode = n_internal
  )

  class(phy) <- "phylo"

  ape::reorder.phylo(phy, order = "cladewise")
}
```

# Generate frozen XML

```{r generate-frozen-xml}
snapshot <- read_snapshot(freeze_source_snapshot_id, beast_output_dir)

freeze_tree <- snapshot_edges_to_phylo(snapshot$tree_edges)
freeze_newick_string <- write.tree(freeze_tree)

state_snapshot <- snapshot$state

n_tips <- length(freeze_tree$tip.label)
n_nodes <- n_tips + freeze_tree$Nnode

freeze_run_name <- paste0(
  "freeze_tree_gt_gibbs_from_",
  sub(".*_snapshot_", "snapshot_", freeze_source_snapshot_id)
)

freeze_xml_path <- file.path(
  xml_dir,
  paste0(experiment_name, "_", freeze_run_name, ".xml")
)

freeze_log_file <- paste0(experiment_name, "_", freeze_run_name, ".log")

freeze_log_path <- file.path(beast_output_dir, freeze_log_file)
freeze_console_log_file <- paste0(experiment_name, "_", freeze_run_name, "_console.log")
freeze_console_log_path <- file.path(beast_output_dir, freeze_console_log_file)

state_ordered <- state_snapshot[order(state_snapshot$node_nr), ]
generation_time_state_string <- paste(
  signif(state_ordered$generation_time, 12),
  collapse = " "
)

initial_beta_value <- unique(state_snapshot$beta)
initial_brownian_variance_value <- unique(state_snapshot$brownian_variance)
initial_residual_variance_value <- unique(state_snapshot$residual_variance)

trait_values_for_xml <- y
trait_string <- paste(
  paste0(names(trait_values_for_xml), "=", signif(trait_values_for_xml, 12)),
  collapse = ","
)

xml_bool <- function(x) tolower(as.character(isTRUE(x)))
xml_path <- function(path) normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)

xml_text <- paste0(
'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

<beast version="2.7"
       namespace="beast.base.inference:beast.base.evolution.tree:gentime">

    <run id="mcmc"
         spec="beast.base.inference.MCMC"
         chainLength="', freeze_chain_length, '">

        <state id="state">

            <tree id="tree"
                  name="stateNode"
                  spec="beast.base.evolution.tree.TreeParser"
                  newick="', freeze_newick_string, '"
                  IsLabelledNewick="true"
                  adjustTipHeights="true"/>

            <parameter id="generationTimes"
                       name="stateNode"
                       spec="parameter.RealParameter"
                       dimension="', n_nodes, '"
                       value="', generation_time_state_string, '"/>

            <parameter id="brownianVariance"
                       name="stateNode"
                       spec="parameter.RealParameter"
                       dimension="1"
                       value="', signif(initial_brownian_variance_value, 12), '"
                       lower="0.0"/>

            <parameter id="beta"
                       name="stateNode"
                       spec="parameter.RealParameter"
                       dimension="1"
                       value="', signif(initial_beta_value, 12), '"/>

            <parameter id="residualVariance"
                       name="stateNode"
                       spec="parameter.RealParameter"
                       dimension="1"
                       lower="0.0"
                       value="', signif(initial_residual_variance_value, 12), '"/>

        </state>

        <distribution id="posterior"
                      spec="beast.base.inference.CompoundDistribution">

            <distribution id="gtLikelihood"
                          spec="gentime.GenerationTimeLikelihood"
                          tree="@tree"
                          generationTimes="@generationTimes"
                          beta="@beta"
                          brownianVariance="@brownianVariance"
                          residualVariance="@residualVariance"
                          priorBetaMean="0.0"
                          priorBetaVariance="1000.0"
                          scale="raw"
                          debug="false">

                <traitData id="gtData"
                           spec="gentime.GenerationTimeTraitData"
                           tree="@tree"
                           value="', trait_string, '"
                           debug="false"/>

                <precisionBuilder id="gtPrecision"
                                  spec="gentime.GenerationTimePrecisionBuilder"
                                  tree="@tree"
                                  debug="false"/>

            </distribution>

            <distribution id="brownianVariancePrior"
                          spec="gentime.GenerationTimeInverseGammaPrior"
                          parameter="@brownianVariance"
                          alpha="2.0"
                          beta="1.0"/>

            <distribution id="residualVariancePrior"
                          spec="gentime.GenerationTimeInverseGammaPrior"
                          parameter="@residualVariance"
                          alpha="2.0"
                          beta="1.0"/>

        </distribution>

        <operator id="gtGibbs"
                  spec="gentime.GenerationTimeGibbsOperatorTest"
                  tree="@tree"
                  generationTimes="@generationTimes"
                  beta="@beta"
                  brownianVariance="@brownianVariance"
                  residualVariance="@residualVariance"
                  traitData="@gtData"
                  precisionBuilder="@gtPrecision"
                  gtLikelihood="@gtLikelihood"
                  priorBetaMean="0.0"
                  priorBetaVariance="1000.0"
                  scale="raw"
                  outputDirectory="', xml_path(beast_output_dir), '"
                  solver="csparsej"
                  compareSolvers="false"
                  maxCgIterations="10000"
                  cgTolerance="1e-5"
                  writePosteriorMean="false"
                  writeLatentPrecisionDiagnostics="false"
                  profile="false"
                  profileFrequency="250"
                  printPrecisionRefresh="true"
                  snapshotFrequency="', freeze_snapshot_frequency, '"
                  snapshotPrefix="freeze_', freeze_run_name, '_snapshot"
                  writeBeta="true"
                  writeGenerationTimes="true"
                  debug="false"
                  weight="0.1"/>

        <operator id="gtVarianceGibbs"
                  spec="gentime.GenerationTimeVarianceGibbsOperator"
                  generationTimes="@generationTimes"
                  brownianVariance="@brownianVariance"
                  precisionBuilder="@gtPrecision"
                  gtLikelihood="@gtLikelihood"
                  tree="@tree"
                  outputDirectory="', xml_path(beast_output_dir), '"
                  writeDiagnostics="false"
                  priorAlpha="2.0"
                  priorBeta="1.0"
                  debug="false"
                  weight="0.1"/>

        <operator id="gtResidualVarianceGibbs"
                  spec="gentime.GenerationTimeResidualVarianceGibbsOperator"
                  tree="@tree"
                  generationTimes="@generationTimes"
                  beta="@beta"
                  residualVariance="@residualVariance"
                  traitData="@gtData"
                  gtLikelihood="@gtLikelihood"
                  priorAlpha="2.0"
                  priorBeta="1.0"
                  scale="raw"
                  debug="false"
                  weight="0.1"/>

        <logger id="screenlog"
                spec="beast.base.inference.Logger"
                logEvery="1000">
            <log idref="posterior"/>
            <log idref="beta"/>
            <log idref="brownianVariance"/>
            <log idref="residualVariance"/>
        </logger>

        <logger id="filelog"
                spec="beast.base.inference.Logger"
                fileName="', freeze_log_file, '"
                logEvery="1">
            <log idref="posterior"/>
            <log idref="beta"/>
            <log idref="brownianVariance"/>
            <log idref="residualVariance"/>
        </logger>

    </run>

</beast>
'
)

writeLines(xml_text, freeze_xml_path)

saveRDS(
  list(
    freeze_source_snapshot_id = freeze_source_snapshot_id,
    experiment_name = experiment_name,
    source_beast_run_name = beast_run_name,
    freeze_run_name = freeze_run_name,
    freeze_xml_path = freeze_xml_path,
    freeze_log_path = freeze_log_path,
    freeze_console_log_path = freeze_console_log_path
  ),
  file.path(beast_output_dir, "freeze_tree_xml_metadata.rds")
)

cat("\nWrote frozen-tree XML to:\n", freeze_xml_path, "\n")
cat(
  "\nRun in Eclipse with:\n\n",
  "-version_file version.xml -overwrite -working \"",
  xml_path(freeze_xml_path),
  "\"\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat("\nAfter the frozen BEAST run finishes, open `08_validate_frozen_tree_conditional_gaussian.Rmd`.\n")
```
